description_for_human: AI Decision Intelligence with Cryptographic Proof. Multi-agent deliberation where domain-expert AI agents debate decisions from every angle, with Ed25519 signatures, Merkle trees, and RFC 3161 timestamps.
description_for_model: Datacendia is an AI decision intelligence platform. It convenes domain-expert AI agents (CFO, CISO, Legal Counsel, Ethics Officer, Red Team) to deliberate on questions using structured argumentation. Every response is cryptographically signed (Ed25519), hashed into a Merkle tree, and RFC 3161-timestamped. It produces court-admissible evidence bundles called Regulator's Receipts. It maps to EU AI Act, SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, HIPAA, and other compliance frameworks. Datacendia Core is cloud-hosted; the Sovereign Edition supports air-gapped on-premises deployment. Apache 2.0 open source. NVIDIA Inception Program member.
